image_description: A close-up shot of a human knee with a beige adhesive bandage (Band-Aid) applied to the skin. The bandage is rectangular with rounded corners, featuring a central white absorbent pad and tan adhesive wings. A hand is partially visible at the top right, appearing to adjust or hold the bandage. The background includes dark clothing and a red textured surface.

The shape is distinctly rectangular with visibly rounded corners, matching the standard Band-Aid silhouette.
